items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: And I guess in a band over the river, Red Allen's daddy. Oh yeah. In the brass band.

ctx.x: All you wanted to do was listen to the music then.

That's all. It's a shame. Couldn't it help? Yeah. I was trying to make my wealth, you see. Mm-hmm. And, but there was such a bunch of fellas that looked like they wasn't interested. All they were interested in making that money and that's all. Nothing else behind them. Yeah. Yeah. And so, fool with them kind of guys, I never would get nowhere. And I guess in a band over the river, Red Allen's daddy. Oh yeah. In the brass band. They didn't have ballrooms too much then. They had them little hole in the wall, you…
No, that's good. That doesn't matter. We talk about everything on these things.
